offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results; paid plans add credits in $5 increments (Hobby: 1,000 credits, Standard: 2,000, Growth: 2,500, Scale: 5,000).
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions 和 URLs；可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认含 query-relevant Highlights；1–10 results=2 credits，11–20=4 credits，向上取整。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR Search
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；可选搜索结果内容抓取
offerings.note: Enterprise plans；Firecrawl 和上游搜索提供商均执行零数据保留。

offerings.name: Anonymized ZDR Search
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；可选搜索结果内容抓取
offerings.note: Enterprise plans；搜索提供商可缓存查询，但查询已完全匿名化。
